programmes.d: In 2015, a slew of Denver bank robberies turns deadly when bandits wearing masks from the horror film Scream stab and shove tellers to the ground, empty the vault and then lead police on a high-speed chase that sees two people shot in cold blood.
North Pole, Alaska is a quiet, safe-haven, best known for Santa Claus. But when the bodies of young women begin turning up one by one, investigators slowly discover the unlikeliest of killers.
A young man hacks his father to pieces with a machete before taking off on a deadly shooting spree throughout Anchorage, Alaska.
The most violent night in the history of Anchorage, Alaska leaves seven dead – including four teens. The small police department is overwhelmed until clues lead them to the unlikeliest of suspects.

The abduction and murder of an 11-year-old girl in an isolated Alaskan village leaves locals fearing they’re being preyed on by an evil outsider until investigators reveal something far more sinister.
Baffled by the animal instincts of a cross country killer whose crimes seem to go dormant in winter, authorities ultimately follow his tracks to a den of deceit in the frozen tundra of Alaska.
Colorado police pursuing a serial killer are horrified when the message on a pager found in the snow near a victim’s abandoned vehicle reveals an unthinkable predator: one sworn to protect and serve.
Police are met with a myriad of theories when a well-known gold miner and political activist vanishes without a trace. Was it an alien abduction, a government conspiracy or cold-blooded murder?
Colorado authorities hone in on a suspect after finding a name tag in a bloody sweatshirt near the scene of a young girl’s murder – but are stunned when DNA reveals they’ve got the wrong man.
When a beloved couple vanishes just before their annual Christmas party, their family fears the worst – and police must do everything possible in order to solve a years-long mystery.
Examines the triangular relationship between politicians, lawmen, and the underworld. Features the murderous Dutch Schultz and his target D.A. Thomas Dewey.
Covers the Kefauver Hearings in 1950 that were the public's first exposure to the depth and brutality of the Mafia's dealings.
Covers the infamous New York mob families from the murder of Paul Castellano outside Sparks Steak House to the new Mafia--brutal gangs from Colombia and Russia.
A probe into the justice system's failure to protect society from career criminals. Focuses on the case of Richard Allen Davis who abducted and murdered 12-year-old Polly Klaas.
Story of the Old West's most murderous villains, including the James Younger gang, the first real bank robbers in America; the Dalton Brothers; and, Butch Cassidy's Wild Bunch.
Covers the fights within unions between the Communists and the Mob, as well as the conflict between gangster Willie Bioff and Hollywood moguls.
A young woman is abducted and put through a horrifying eight day ordeal by a man who forces her to live inside a metal box.
A young mother is attacked and strangled by a man she meets at a party. A snowmobiler survives a series of avalanches but loses eight of his friends.

Renowned filmmaker Tyler Perry becomes personally involved in a case that has sparked outrage, when 27-year-old Terrance Williams disappears after he was last seen getting into the back of a police car in Naples, Florida. Now streaming on Paramount+.
What happened to 18-year old Caleb Diehl, a free-spirited adventurer who left town for the day but was supposed to return that night? A prominent local businessman knows more than he is saying.
Caleb Diehl is missing. His Texan family learns that a close family friend who employs Caleb on his ranch harbors dark secrets.
Ashley dreams of escaping the impoverished life lived by her indigenous community on the Blackfeet Indian Reservation in Montana. Is that why she goes missing? Or did she meet a more sinister fate?

Heather was a cheerleader and an all-American girl who wanted to be a psychologist, until she is brutally abducted while sunbathing on a public beach in Kentucky. A red Bronco parked nearby is a promising clue.
After Susan and her 14-year-old son disappear, her friends and family panic. Meanwhile, her second husband claims Susan ran away. But did he have a secret life that she discovered?
One of five siblings in a close hard-working immigrant family, Michael Samdass is the life of the party. And then he simply disappears.

Cortney Lake is a young single mother and beauty pageant contestant who gets caught up in an abusive relationship. When her mother returns home from a barbecue and Cortney isn't there, she knows something is wrong.
Ali Gilmore was a graduate of Florida A&M who worked two jobs and is held in high regard by everyone who knows her. But her complicated romantic life only comes to light after she goes missing.
The foster parents of 4-year-old Oakley Carlson reluctantly accept it when they must surrender her back to her biological parents. But when she disappears they begin a frantic search for answers.
Jon Riley loves sailing, rock climbing and the great outdoors. But when he goes missing and a human foot washes up in a nearby lake, his family fears the worst. Only, it's not Jon's. So where is he?
Where is Susan Walsh? The list of those who might have meant her harm is impressive-the Russian mob, the Mafia, a vampire cult, and a jealous estranged husband.
Susan Walsh is bright, beautiful, and ambitious. But as she builds a career in journalism and moonlights as an exotic dancer, she may have made a fatal enemy.
When 5-year-old Tamra Keepness goes missing from her home, an entire city rallies to find "everyone's baby." Then, suspicion falls on her grieving family.
In Part 2, the police and Indigenous community continue the search for 5-year-old Tamra Keepness. A mysterious online tip raises hopes.

Chelsea is a young mother with a vibrant personality, but the loss of a family member sends her into a deep depression. Her distraught mother believes two individuals she meets on a psych ward are behind her sudden disappearance.
